name: Daal Mash
description: Pakistani daal mash with tender split urad lentils, tomato masala and a fragrant cumin-garlic base, finished with garam masala, ginger and coriander.
ingredients: Salt to taste and fresh coriander for finishing
method: Rinse the mash dal thoroughly, soak it for about 30 minutes, then drain.
Cook the dal in fresh water with turmeric and salt at a gentle simmer until the grains are tender but still retain some shape; add hot water in small amounts if needed rather than flooding the pot.
In a separate pan, heat the oil or ghee and fry the cumin seeds, sliced garlic and onion until aromatic and golden.
Add the tomatoes, red chilli powder and green chillies and cook until the tomatoes soften into a cohesive masala.
Fold the cooked dal into the masala and simmer gently until the flavours combine and the consistency is thick and creamy, stirring carefully so all the lentils do not break down.
Finish with garam masala, julienned ginger and fresh coriander, then taste for salt before serving hot.
